text:
```yaml
name: Bump Progressive Rollout Version
permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]
jobs:
  bump-version:
    name: Bump Progressive Rollout Version
    if: >
      github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
      contains(github.event.pull_request.body, '/bump-progressive-rollout-version') ||
      contains(github.event.pull_request.title, '/bump-progressive-rollout-version')
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Get PR info
        id: pr-info
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          PR_JSON=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/pulls/${{ github.event.pull_request.number }})
          echo "PR_JSON: $PR_JSON"
          echo "repo=$(echo "$PR_JSON" | jq -r .head.repo.full_name)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          BRANCH=$(echo "$PR_JSON" | jq -r .head.ref)
          echo "branch=$BRANCH" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "run-url=https://github.com/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          LATEST_COMMIT=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/commits/$BRANCH | jq -r .sha)
          echo "latest_commit=$LATEST_COMMIT" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Checkout Airbyte
        uses: actions/checkout@08eba0b27e820071cde6df949e0beb9ba4906955 # v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT_APPROVINGTON_OCTAVIA }}

      - name: Install airbyte-ci
        run: |
          python airbyte-ci/connectors/pipelines/pipelines/external_scripts/airbyte_ci_install.py latest

      - name: Bump version with RC suffix
        id: bump-version
        run: |
          echo "Running airbyte-ci connectors --modified bump-version --rc"
          ./airbyte-ci/connectors/pipelines/pipelines/external_scripts/airbyte_ci_run.py connectors --modified bump-version --rc

      - name: Create Pull Request
        id: create-pr
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@67cc811551111000120000000000000000000000 # v6.0.5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT_APPROVINGTON_OCTAVIA }}
          commit-message: "Bump connector versions for progressive rollout"
          title: "Bump connector versions for progressive rollout"
          body: |
            This PR was automatically created by the `/bump-progressive-rollout-version` slash command.

            Next steps:
            1. Review the version bumps in the changes
            2. Ensure the bumped versions are correct for progressive rollout
            3. Merge this PR to finalize the version bumps

            For more information about progressive rollouts, see the [progressive rollout documentation](https://docs.airbyte.com/connector-development/advanced-features/progressive-rollout).
          branch: bump-progressiverollout-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          delete-branch: true

      - name: Comment on PR
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@71345be0265236311c031f5c7866368bd1eff043 # v4.0.0
        with:
          issue-number: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          body: |
            I've created a PR to bump the connector versions for progressive rollout: ${{ steps.create-pr.outputs.pull-request-url }}

            Next steps:
            1. Review the version bumps in the changes
            2. Ensure the bumped versions are correct for progressive rollout
            3. Merge this PR to finalize the version bumps

            For more information about progressive rollouts, see the [progressive rollout documentation](https://docs.airbyte.com/connector-development/advanced-features/progressive-rollout).
```
